## Activity

During February 2019, Central Eye Clinic completed 151 captures. Activity was delivered as scheduled, with session lists managed through the reporting period. The available information indicates that routine service arrangements supported the planned screening workload. Staff maintained the expected flow of image capture and submission, allowing completed examinations to proceed for grading without reported operational disruption.

The activity total provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes at the site. It also supports comparison with local service expectations and ongoing monitoring of the screening pathway.

## Image quality

The image quality review recorded 2 ungradable examinations. This represents an ungradable rate of 1.3 of all captures. The result should be monitored as part of routine quality assurance, with feedback used to support consistent image acquisition and to identify any need for additional staff guidance.

## Grading

Grading identified 25 referable results. The median grading lag was 7. This measure provides an indication of the time between image submission and completion of grading during February 2019. Results requiring further clinical consideration should continue to be managed through the established referral process. Session lists ran as planned apart from routine leave.
